stages.title: Can one model handle six different jobs?
stages.desc: No. Search, images, video, claims and calls each need a different kind of model.

stages.title: What does Azure AI Foundry actually offer?
stages.desc: Embeddings, image and video generation, vision, speech to text and text to speech — one catalog.

end.title: Stop forcing one model to do six jobs
end.sub: Azure AI Foundry's catalog: embeddings for search, GPT-image-1 for visuals, Sora 2 for video, GPT-4.1 for vision, GPT-4o-transcribe and GPT-4o-tts for voice — one platform, one set of Azure controls.

post.caption:
Most teams reach for one chat model and try to make it do everything. Azure AI Foundry’s catalog is built the other way: a specific model for each kind of problem.

Embeddings (Ada, Cohere) turn a customer question into a search that matches by meaning, not keywords. GPT-image-1 turns a product brief into a full image set. Sora 2 turns a script into a test ad before a shoot is ever booked. GPT-4.1 reads a claim photo and drafts the report. GPT-4o-transcribe and GPT-4o-tts turn a support call into searchable text and a spoken confirmation.

Same project, same governance, six very different jobs.

Which of these would save your team the most time?

How a multimodal model and speech models turn a photo or a phone call directly into structured, actionable data.

faq.q: Why does semantic search find a policy that shares no words with the question?
faq.a: Embedding models like Ada and Cohere convert both the question and the documents into vectors that represent meaning, not exact text. "Can I return shoes that got wet in the rain?" and "items damaged by weather are refunded in full" share zero keywords but sit near each other in vector space, so the match still surfaces — a keyword search would return nothing.

faq.q: Can one Azure AI Foundry project really cover search, images, video, claims, and support calls?
faq.a: Yes. Embeddings, GPT-image-1, Sora 2, GPT-4.1, and the GPT-4o transcribe/tts pair are all separate task-built models sitting in the same catalog under the same project, so one team's Foundry setup can back retail search, marketing creative, claims triage, and voice support without standing up separate infrastructure for each.
